introChoice.title: Whole-Number Division (//)
introChoice.prompt: In Python, single `/` gives a decimal (`7 / 2` is `3.5`), while double `//` does whole-number division and drops any leftover (`7 // 2` is `3`).
introChoice.question: What does `20 // 6` equal?

choices.explanation: Nice! 6 fits into 20 three full times (`6 * 3 = 18`), so `20 // 6` is `3`.
`2` is the leftover (`20 % 6`), while `20 // 6` asks how many full times 6 fits into 20.
That is regular `/` division! Double `//` drops the decimal part and gives a whole number.
`//` always rounds down, never up. `6 * 4 = 24` is too big!
